title: Explicit bounded queue, ordering, reliability, deadline, retry, overflow, and backpressure
statement: The X-Verse platform must expose explicit bounded queue, ordering, reliability, deadline, retry, overflow, and backpressure policy with fail-closed overflow semantics.
applicability: X-Verse capability 007; T020 verifies the declared decode bounds only; runtime enforcement is a later task.
verification_intent: Realized for the T020 test slice by T020-SR-004.
acceptance_criteria: Every declared DecodeLimits bound is finite and exercised at and over its value.
A limit below 1 and any breach fails closed with no decoded value.
